 Order
Heard on IA.2165 of 2023, which is an application under Section 378(3) Cr.P.C. moved on behalf of State against the judgment of acquittal dated 30.09.2022 passed by First Additional Sessions Judge [Special Judge (Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012), Seodha, District Datia (Madhya Pradesh) in Special Case No.06/2016, whereby the respondent has been acquitted of the charges levelled against him under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
opennyai_summary.decision:
IA No.3438/2023, an application preferred under Section 5 of the Limitation Act is taken up,
considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein and the delay of 26 days in filing present appeal stands condoned.
I n the light of the findings of the Special Court which are based on critical evaluation of the evidence on record, conclusion of acquittal drawn particularly in view of paragraphs 48, 49, 50, 51,
52 of the impugned judgment is found to be impregnable.
Accordingly, IA.2165 of 2023 is rejected.
Consequently, present appeal stands dismissed.
